data.text: scripts/install-smoke.mjs installs the packed tarball with npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, and bunx --bun (Bun running the code), in a throwaway git project, then drives --version, schema --json, init, task add, task list, search, prime and hook prompt - 11 checks. Locally on macOS: all five pass on 0.8.0. Seen to fail first on a tarball with dist/cli.js removed - and that run found something: npx, pnpm exec and bunx fall back to any kadence on PATH when the package installed no bin, so a global 0.7.0 answered and most checks passed. The script now checks the bin is in the project's node_modules. CI job 'install': 3 OS x 5 managers. Windows not yet run - it runs only on GitHub. Core untouched, timing not re-measured; 1187 tests green.
